definitions.explanation: Gold beaten into extremely thin sheets, used to decorate buildings, crafts, lacquerware and even food.

examples.japanese: {金箔|きんぱく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧。
{金箔|きんぱく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧のせた⟦アイスクリーム→アイスクリーム：03830_aisukuriimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: Ice cream topped with gold leaf is popular.

examples.japanese: ⟦{金閣寺|きんかくじ}→金閣寺：31029_kinkakuji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{階|かい}→階：01034_kai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{金箔|きんぱく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{覆|おお}われている→覆う：02020_oou⟧。
examples.english: At Kinkakuji, the upper floors of the building are covered in gold leaf.

notes:
{金|きん} (gold) + {箔|はく} (foil, leaf). {金沢|かなざわ} produces almost all of Japan's gold leaf, and gold-leaf crafts and sweets are a famous local specialty.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金箔|きんぱく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧: to apply gold leaf
- {金箔|きんぱく}{入|い}り: containing gold leaf (sake, sweets)
- {金箔|きんぱく}{張|ば}り: gold-leafed

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{緊迫|きんぱく}→緊迫：05918_kinpaku⟧ (tension) has the same reading.
